source.note: migration file is uncommitted at contract time; sha256 below is authoritative

backup.production_rule: additive only: one new service-role table with RLS and an index; no existing object is altered, so the 2026-09-10 D-061 drill set (restore-proven) is an adequate restore point and no fresh backup is taken

stop_conditions: public.concierge_handoffs already exists with a different column set
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
this release creates the table only; the Telegram card path goes live with the messenger-concierge and telegram-expense deploys that follow

forward_verification.name: concierge_handoffs_exists_with_rls
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.concierge_handoffs') is not null and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.concierge_handoffs'::regclass)

forward_verification.name: concierge_handoffs_status_check_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.concierge_handoffs'::regclass and contype = 'c'

feature_flags.name: concierge_mode
feature_flags.required_state: handoff cards are produced only in auto mode; suggest mode keeps the existing draft card; off produces nothing

rollback.safe_until: any time; the table holds only handoff cards that the bot recreates on the next handoff
